title: Add persisted alert state machine
acceptance: WHEN record_trigger is called for a position/alert_type with no existing row THE SYSTEM SHALL insert status='first_trigger' and should_notify SHALL return True.
WHEN record_trigger is called again within 6 hours at a price within 0.5% of the stored extreme THE SYSTEM SHALL leave status unchanged and should_notify SHALL return False.
WHEN record_trigger is called with a price worse than the stored extreme by more than 0.5% THE SYSTEM SHALL set status='new_extreme' and should_notify SHALL return True.
WHEN more than 6 hours have elapsed since last_notified_at with no new extreme THE SYSTEM SHALL set status='periodic_reminder' and should_notify SHALL return True.
WHEN resolve is called THE SYSTEM SHALL set status='resolved' with resolved_at non-null, and a subsequent record_trigger SHALL start a fresh first_trigger cycle.

WHEN price recovers above stop_loss THE SYSTEM SHALL call resolve, and a subsequent breach THE SYSTEM SHALL notify immediately.
